s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of hip pain and difficulty walking in an elderly patient with a history of osteoporosis treatment and previous hip surgery
salient_findings: Incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck
key_facts: 76-year-old woman
One week of right hip pain
Difficulty walking
Received denosumab for osteoporosis for five years
Underwent total hip arthroplasty for a left femoral neck fracture two years earlier
JOA score was 96 on the right and 76 on the left
Initial plain radiographs were reportedly normal
Repeat radiographs demonstrated an incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck
Bone mineral density was 0.840 g/cm2 in the lumbar spine and 0.899 g/cm2 in the right femoral neck
Laboratory studies revealed abnormal levels of calcium, phosphorus, alkaline phosphatase, and other bone turnover markers

shortlist.label: Atypical femoral fracture
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of denosumab treatment and presented with an incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck

shortlist.label: Osteonecrosis of the femoral head
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of total hip arthroplasty and presented with hip pain and difficulty walking

shortlist.label: Stress fracture
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of osteoporosis treatment and presented with an incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck

raw.rationale: The patient's history of long-term denosumab use, incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck, and lack of comminution are consistent with an atypical femoral fracture

rejected.label: Osteonecrosis of the femoral head
rejected.why: There is no mention of femoral head involvement or necrosis in the vignette

rejected.label: Stress fracture
rejected.why: The fracture pattern and location are more consistent with an atypical femoral fracture than a stress fracture

rejected.label: Denosumab-related fracture
rejected.why: While denosumab use is a risk factor, this is not a specific diagnosis and atypical femoral fracture is a more precise term

rejected.label: Osteoporotic fracture
rejected.why: The patient's bone mineral density is low, but the fracture pattern and location are more consistent with an atypical femoral fracture than a typical osteoporotic fracture
